d: In this video, Firstpost explains the fire at the Savannah River National Laboratory in South Carolina, a research facility linked to the US nuclear weapons programme. The blaze was extinguished, one employee was taken to hospital with minor injuries, and officials reported no detectable radioactive contamination beyond the affected facility. The emergency was later terminated and protective measures lifted. But why is this site so important to America’s nuclear arsenal? We examine its Cold War origins, its role in nuclear materials management and research, and plans for a major plutonium…
